Package com.okta.sdk.resource.application

Class PartialApplicationUpdater

java.lang.Object
com.okta.sdk.resource.application.PartialApplicationUpdater
public final class PartialApplicationUpdater extends Object
Helper for updating an Application when the caller only has a subset of its properties to change (OKTA-1228269).

The Admin Management API's PUT /api/v1/apps/{appId} (backing ApplicationApi.replaceApplication(java.lang.String, com.okta.sdk.resource.model.Application)) is a full-replace endpoint - the spec requires every required property on every call, and there is no PATCH operation for applications. Sending a partial Application (or subtype, e.g. OpenIdConnectApplication) directly to replaceApplication is rejected with a 400, because the server can't validate or resolve the application's concrete type from an incomplete body.

This helper works around that by fetching the current application, overlaying only the properties set on the caller's partial object, and replacing with the merged, fully-populated result - giving callers effective partial-update semantics without violating the API's full-replace contract.

Because the overlay only applies properties that are set (non-null) on partialApplication, this is a merge, not a JSON Merge Patch: explicitly setting a property to null does not clear it on the existing application. Call ApplicationApi.replaceApplication(java.lang.String, com.okta.sdk.resource.model.Application) directly with a fully-populated object to clear a property.

partialApplication must be the same concrete subtype as the application being updated (e.g. both OpenIdConnectApplication) - merging across subtypes would blend fields from incompatible application types, so it's rejected up front rather than producing a confusing server-side error.

Since:
25.0.5

  • Method Details

    • partialUpdateApplication

      public static Application partialUpdateApplication(ApiClient apiClient, String appId, Application partialApplication) throws ApiException
      Fetches the application identified by appId, overlays the properties set on partialApplication onto it, and replaces the application with the merged result.
      Parameters:
      apiClient - the ApiClient to use for the underlying get/replace calls
      appId - the id of the application to update
      partialApplication - an Application (or subtype) with only the changed properties set
      Returns:
      the updated Application as returned by the API
      Throws:
      ApiException - if the underlying get or replace call fails

    • mergeApplication

      public static Application mergeApplication(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper objectMapper, Application existingApplication, Application partialApplication)
      Overlays the properties set on partialApplication onto existingApplication, returning a new, fully-populated Application suitable for ApplicationApi.replaceApplication(java.lang.String, com.okta.sdk.resource.model.Application).

      Exposed separately from partialUpdateApplication(com.okta.sdk.resource.client.ApiClient, java.lang.String, com.okta.sdk.resource.model.Application) so the merge itself can be exercised without a live ApiClient.

      Parameters:
      objectMapper - the ObjectMapper to serialize/merge/deserialize with - use ApiClient.getObjectMapper() so the same Application-subtype null-omission and polymorphism behavior applies
      existingApplication - the current, fully-populated application
      partialApplication - an Application (or subtype) with only the changed properties set
      Returns:
      the merged, fully-populated Application
